title: Pseudo-coherent replacement preserving universal cohomology
statement: Let f:X→T be proper of finite presentation and F finitely presented and flat over T, with injective resolutions on X. Let U⊆T be affine containing t, and C a quasi-coherent complex on U concentrated in [0,d], termwise flat over U, whose ordinary pullbacks compute R^q f′_*g′*F for every cartesian base change and q∈ℕ. Then there is a complex D on the SAME U concentrated in [0,d], termwise flat and quasi-coherent, whose global-sections complex is pseudo-coherent. For every g:T′→U and q∈ℕ, H^q(g*D) is isomorphic to H^q(g*C).

proof.text: Apply the fixed-affine finite-presentation flat model theorem to f,F,U, obtaining B in [0,b] and its comparisons with every base-changed higher direct image. No restriction of U is made.

For any g:T′→U, choose the standard pullback X′=X×_T T′. X′.Modules is Grothendieck abelian and has injective resolutions. Compose B’s comparison to R^q f′_*g′*F with the inverse of hcomp to get H^q(g*B)≅H^q(g*C). This uses actual isomorphism composition and applies to nonaffine T′.

For every s∈U and q>d, C^q is zero by hCle. Ordinary module pullback preserves zero objects, and the homology of a complex with zero term in degree q is zero there. Transport that vanishing along the previous comparison to prove residue-field homology of B vanishes above d. Apply affine finite-presentation flat shortening to B to obtain D in [0,d], with flat and quasi-coherent terms, pseudo-coherent global sections, and pullback homology comparisons D≅B.
Compose H^q(g*D)≅H^q(g*B) with H^q(g*B)≅H^q(g*C). Pair the result with the five structural properties of D. This is the required unchanged conclusion. No data is chosen in a definition.

theorem proper_flat_cohomology_model_properties {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules)
    [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [HasInjectiveResolutions X.Modules] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hF : F.IsFlatOver f) (t : T) (U : T.Opens)
    (C : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (ht : t ∈ U) (hU : IsAffine U.toScheme) (hCge : C.IsStrictlyGE 0)
    (hCle : C.IsStrictlyLE d)
    (hCflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 U.toScheme))
    (hCqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hcomp :
      ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
        [HasInjectiveResolutions X'.Modules], IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι) → ∀ q : ℕ,
        Nonempty ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C).homology q ≅
          (higherDirectImage f' q).obj ((Modules.pullback g').obj F))) :
    ∃ D : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ,
      D.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ D.IsStrictlyLE d ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (D.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 U.toScheme)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (D.X n).IsQuasicoherent) ∧
      (letI : CommRing (U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (.op ⊤)) :=
        inferInstanceAs (CommRing Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤));
        letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
          (ModuleCat.{u} (U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (.op ⊤)));
        DerivedCategory.IsPseudoCoherent (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf (.op ⊤)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D))) ∧
      ∀ {T' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (q : ℕ),
        Nonempty ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj D).homology q ≅
          (((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C).homology q)
